[SWS_DM_01213].
7.3.2.4 Diagnostic Service Authentication checks
The UDS service Authentication (0x29) is used by the ECU as a means to identify the
client and provide the relevant access to diagnostic resources, based on the client’s
‘role’. Depending on the authenticated role and the access-list, a dynamic set of di-
agnostic services is available to the client. The
Diagnostic Server instance
verifies if a received diagnostic service is accessible to the client or not.
